title: OMENLY
tagline: A small arcade. Made by hand. Play in a browser.

games.title: ECHO
games.blurb: The lights are gone. Ping to listen — run when they ping back. Five things hunt you in the dark: a stalker, a howler, a hunter, a tank, a whisperer. Manage your battery, descend deeper.
games.controls: WASD + click + F/X (desktop) · joystick + PING + FLASH/EMP (mobile)

games.title: Porchlight
games.blurb: One Halloween. Six porches. A small American street, a half-full pillowcase, and a few small choices that stay with you.

games.title: Ashenreach
games.blurb: Twenty-three years after the fire, you walk back into the valley. Five names to find. One altar. Things in the dark that did not leave.

games.title: Stillhunt
games.blurb: Dawn on the ridge. Mist in the hollows. Six shells in your pocket. A bolt-action hunting shooter in pseudo-3D.
games.controls: mouse + click / SPACE (desktop) · joystick + FIRE button (mobile)

games.title: Carve
games.blurb: One blade. One road. They come up the road and they do not stop. A short, hot, pseudo-3D arcade slash.
games.controls: click + A/D (desktop) · tap to slash, tap edges to step (mobile)

games.title: Blacksite
games.blurb: A CIA ghost in a hostile facility. Steal the intel. Stay out of the cones. Crouch and they don't hear you — usually.

games.title: Raccoon
games.blurb: Raccoon City, after dark. An RPD operative with a handgun, a small map, and a lot of zombies in the way. Third-person 3D survival.
games.controls: WASD + mouse + click (desktop) · joystick + look + FIRE (mobile)

games.title: Siteline
games.blurb: A 5v5 bombsite FPS in your browser. Three maps — office, dust, dust 2. Handguns, AK, bullpup. HE, flash, smoke. Paste a code to join a friend. Up to 50 players, or play solo against CPU bots.
games.controls: WASD + mouse + click + R/G/F/B (desktop) · joystick + FIRE + side buttons (mobile)

games.title: Clash
games.blurb: A 3D browser fighting game. Seven fighters, each with a unique special — slam, teleport-strike, burn, grapple-slam, plasma beam, freeze, iaido. Solo campaign, ranked ladder, friends room. Kbd / gamepad / touch.
games.controls: WASD + J/K/L/I (desktop) · gamepad · joystick + on-screen buttons (mobile)

games.title: Nocturne
games.blurb: A pixel-noir whodunit. One apartment floor. Five neighbours. One killer. Knock, listen, watch what they do through the keyhole. Lock three tells in your notebook and accuse before dawn.
